description:
As an operator choosing the system default model, and a person chatting
  I want a change of model to apply to the next answer without a restart,
  and to see which model answered, why, and since when
  So that I can trust the model I chose is the model that served the reply

elements.name: An agent with its own model keeps it and is listed when the default changes

steps.name: the stub providers "openai", "bdd-provider-b" and "bdd-provider-c" are configured with models "gpt-5.4-mini", "claude-5-sonnet, claude-5-haiku" and "qwen-5-turbo"
the system default model is "openai/gpt-5.4-mini"
an agent "BDD Agent Aurora" with the model "openai/gpt-5.4-mini" exists
an agent "BDD Agent Cirrus" with the extension model "bdd-provider-c/qwen-5-turbo" exists
an agent "BDD Agent Dawn" with no model exists
the operator changes the system default to "bdd-provider-b/claude-5-haiku"
the change result lists exactly "BDD Agent Aurora" and "BDD Agent Cirrus" as pinned
the change result's follow count equals the number of other agents
I switch to a fresh conversation using "BDD Agent Aurora"
I send the message "S1 r8 aurora"
the reply to "S1 r8 aurora" came from "openai/gpt-5.4-mini"
I switch the active agent to "BDD Agent Cirrus"
I send the message "S1 r8 cirrus"
the reply to "S1 r8 cirrus" came from "bdd-provider-c/qwen-5-turbo"
I switch the active agent to "BDD Agent Dawn"
I send the message "S1 r8 dawn"
